question: Six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Q is an immediate neighbour of S and T. U sits to the immediate right of R. P sits third to the left of T. Neither S nor T sit on any of the extreme ends. Who sits at the extreme left end?
